summary: Allow a VM to attach an install ISO from any storage on its host. API impact: changed contract.

guide.reason: Create, edit and storage pages no longer require the install ISO to share a repository with the VM disks.

api.reason: API impact: changed contract. createVM, updateVM and mediaVM no longer 409 when media_id storage differs from the VM disk repositories; the ISO must still be verified on the placement host.

roadmap.reason: Corrects ISO attachment policy; does not complete a milestone.

state.reason: No new durable record; ISO and disk placements stay on existing Core journal entries.

verification.method: Run focused Go tests for create/insert with ISO and disks on different repositories, plus UI typecheck/test. Browser wizard and native host attach were not run.
